title: Estimation of the sub-Gaussian Parameter
summary: The sub-Gaussian parameter (also called the variance proxy) of a mean-zero random variable $X$ is defined as $ξ^2_\star = \sup_{λ\in \mathbb{R}} L(λ)$ where $L(λ) = \frac{2}{λ^2} \log \mathbb{E} e^{λX}$ is a weighted cumulant generating function. We study the estimation of $ξ^2_\star$ and prove that the minimax risk is governed by a non-increasing function $δ_P(C) = \sup_{|λ| \geq C} L(λ) - \sup_{|λ| \leq C} L(λ)$ which captures the influence of the tail behavior of the distribution $P$.
